newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's Caldera says backs cabinet fully.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's Caldera says backs cabinet fully.

text.p: Venezuelan President Rafael Caldera said Sunday he fully backed his economic team and, contrary to market rumours circulating late last week, did not contemplate any cabinet changes whatsoever.

"I just want to say that there'll be no changes in the economic cabinet...their work is excellent, and any rumours to the contrary are completely wrong," Caldera told a press conference held in the Presidential residence, La Casona.
"The Venezuelan Agenda is going ahead as planned, firmly," he said.
"Now we're moving on to the second stage, Venezuelan Agenda part two, the reactivation of the Venezuelan economy."
Caldera was accompanied by Finance Minister Luis Raul Matos Azocar and Commerce and Trade Minister Freddy Rojas Parra.
Planning Minister Teodoro Petkoff "is enroute to a meeting of investors in Amsterdam and that's why he cannot be here with us," Caldera said.
